OzyVTT · polish · consistency sweep 3

Before and after

The third sweep's twenty fixes, each drawn from the approved mockups as they were and as they are with the fix made in their sources. Press a picture, or its toggle, to switch between before and after; the after state has an amber frame. The findings themselves are in history/3-sweep.html.

1

Settings draws its groups as full boxes

Fix: Settings' groups are Cradles; the players' rows sit in their group with no box of their own.

2

Arrival's Cups carry an arrow

Fix: Arrival's Cups are words only.

3

Phone controls are drawn at laptop size

Fix: On a phone every button, chip, icon button and Cup is at least 44 px tall; the header's icons and a sheet's close are 44 by 44.

4

Danger is drawn four ways

Fix: The label in --danger-text on its Base line; in a menu a --danger-text row with the bin.

5

Ghost buttons stand in for secondaries

Fix: A ghost only for Cancel or Back beside a Cup; every other secondary on its Base line.

6

More than two display titles in a view

Fix: The roster's names in Bai Jamjuree 600; a step's or a column's head is an eyebrow.

7

The character builder's Steps rail

Fix: Done a solid cyan box with a dark tick, the current step a 3 px cyan edge, as Prep's rail.

8

Three phone sheets lose the horizon edge

Fix: The horizon on the top edge of every phone sheet.

9

The phone table's switch sits in a well

Fix: Base lines and no well, as C draws it.

10

Two switches

Fix: One switch: the 46 by 26 track with its glow.

11

Picking several: ticks or switches

Fix: Ticks for picking several from a list; a switch for one setting.

12

Icon buttons and a row's More

Fix: 36 px on the Base line; a row's More is the dots.

The table screen's plain icons turned out to be the preview's head and the phone header, which stay plain icons as overlay heads and headers do; its header's + grows to 44 px with finding 3.

13

Row heights

Fix: Menu rows 48 px, table rows 48 px, phone rows at least 44 px.

The table screen's turn order on a phone is the TV's own display, not a control, so it keeps its rows.

14

Base line buttons at 34 px

Fix: 36 px on a laptop.

15

Colours outside their meaning

Fix: A condition red; the timeline's edge grey, cyan when chosen; GET and POST in the dim text colour.

16

Dates, times and counts

Fix: "Oct 30, 7:40 PM" and "Today, 8:41 PM" in Bai Jamjuree; maps' chips "All maps 6" at 44 px.

17

Empty states without their button

Fix: One line and one secondary button that fixes it.

18

Copy: pronouns, an ellipsis, Done

Fix: Characters by name, "None" in an empty field, Done to leave a making flow.

19

The GM ONLY tag

Fix: One tag, 16 px in a 22 px box.

20

Widths against rule 11

Fix: Settings' column 880 px beside its side list; the Codex's measure 680 px.
